say:1:1430224101:1.text: That's because all the flowers I sell are among the rarest and most exquisite.
say:1:1430224101:1.source_cn: 那是因为我卖的所有花都是珍稀品种！
say:1:1430224101:1.male: That's because all the flowers I sell are among the rarest and most exquisite.
say:1:1430224101:1.female: That's because all the flowers I sell are among the rarest and most exquisite.

say:2:1430224102:1.text: The nobles pay their weight in gold to flaunt their status and show others what they cannot possess.
say:2:1430224102:1.source_cn: 王城内的贵族们喜欢珍稀的花，以展现自己的地位。
say:2:1430224102:1.male: The nobles pay their weight in gold to flaunt their status and show others what they cannot possess.
say:2:1430224102:1.female: The nobles pay their weight in gold to flaunt their status and show others what they cannot possess.
